presets.label: Overall analog
presets.blurb: Every trait counts equally (air pressure excluded: no place on Earth comes close).

presets.label: Rover & landing tests
presets.blurb: Terrain that drives, lands and navigates like the target: slope, roughness, relief, bare loose ground.

presets.label: Polar base operations
presets.blurb: Low sun, long shadows, cold and ice nearby: lighting, power and thermal design for a south-pole base.

presets.label: Ice prospecting & ISRU
presets.blurb: Frozen ground under dry, bare terrain: drilling, ground-penetrating radar and water extraction trials.

presets.label: Instrument & remote sensing
presets.blurb: Surfaces that look the same to cameras and spectrometers: albedo, bare ground, no vegetation, dry air.

presets.label: Crew & EVA training
presets.blurb: Places where people can rehearse surface operations: walkable slopes, harsh cold and dry conditions, isolation.

earth.radiation: ~2.4 mSv/yr at sea level (magnetic field + atmosphere)

targets.name: Peak near Cabeus B
targets.blurb: Elevated peak near Cabeus B with good sunlight and Earth view, beside Cabeus cold traps where LCROSS detected water.

targets.name: Haworth
targets.blurb: Region by Haworth crater, a large permanently shadowed cold trap likely to hold water ice.

targets.name: Malapert Massif
targets.blurb: Tall massif with continuous Earth line of sight and long sunlit periods near polar cold traps.

targets.name: Mons Mouton Plateau
targets.blurb: Broad plateau next to Mons Mouton; flat sunlit terrain near shadowed craters that may trap volatiles.

targets.name: Mons Mouton
targets.blurb: Lunar south pole mountain chosen for VIPER; sunlit slopes beside cold traps that may hold water ice.

targets.name: Nobile Rim 1
targets.blurb: Rim of Nobile crater, whose shadowed floor is a cold trap and potential water ice reservoir.

targets.name: Nobile Rim 2
targets.blurb: Second Nobile rim region with access to ancient crust and nearby permanently shadowed regions.

targets.name: de Gerlache Rim 2
targets.blurb: Rim of de Gerlache crater near the pole, with high illumination and shadowed cold traps close by.

targets.name: Slater Plain
targets.blurb: Plains north of Slater crater, added in 2024; relatively smooth terrain near south polar cold traps.

targets.name: Shackleton rim / Connecting Ridge
targets.blurb: Ridge linking Shackleton and de Gerlache; near-continuous sunlight next to Shackleton's permanently shadowed floor.

targets.name: Jezero crater (Perseverance)
targets.blurb: Ancient lake delta where Perseverance caches samples for Mars Sample Return and seeks biosignatures.

targets.name: Gale crater (Curiosity)
targets.blurb: Layered Mount Sharp sediments record a habitable lake environment and Mars' shift to a drier climate.

targets.name: Oxia Planum (Rosalind Franklin)
targets.blurb: Clay-rich Noachian plains where the rover will drill 2 m deep to search for preserved organic molecules.

targets.name: Utopia Planitia (Viking 2)
targets.blurb: Viking 2 saw winter frost here; Utopia's mid-latitude plains hold extensive buried ground ice.

targets.name: Southern Utopia Planitia (Zhurong)
targets.blurb: Zhurong's radar found buried layered deposits, hinting at past water at the edge of a possible northern ocean.

targets.name: Elysium Planitia (InSight)
targets.blurb: Flat equatorial plain where InSight's seismometer mapped Mars' crust, mantle and core.

targets.name: Meridiani Planum (Opportunity)
targets.blurb: Hematite plains where Opportunity found sulfate sandstones from ancient acidic groundwater.

targets.name: Gusev crater (Spirit)
targets.blurb: Spirit found silica deposits at Home Plate, evidence of ancient hot springs or fumaroles.

targets.name: Green Valley (Phoenix)
targets.blurb: Phoenix scraped into shallow water ice and detected perchlorate in polar soil.

targets.name: Arcadia Planitia (SpaceX Starship candidate)
targets.blurb: Mid-latitude plains with shallow ground ice mapped by SWIM; a leading candidate for crewed landings.

targets.name: Deuteronilus Mensae
targets.blurb: Lobate debris aprons that SHARAD shows are buried glacial ice, a water resource for human explorers.

targets.name: Chryse Planitia (Viking 1)
targets.blurb: First successful Mars landing; outflow channel plains where Viking ran the first life-detection experiments.

targets.name: Ares Vallis (Mars Pathfinder)
targets.blurb: Flood-deposited boulders at the mouth of Ares Vallis, explored by Sojourner, the first Mars rover.

targets.name: Melas Chasma (Valles Marineris)
targets.blurb: Central Valles Marineris trough with hydrated sulfates and layered deposits; proposed human exploration zone.

targets.name: Arsia Mons cave skylights
targets.mission: Mars Odyssey THEMIS / MRO HiRISE cave candidates
targets.blurb: Seven candidate lava-tube skylights on the north flank of Arsia Mons: radiation-shielded shelter for crews and a place where ice and biosignatures could survive.
